decisions.reason: The aloe vera line has a page of its own in both years, which signals that results meet management's aspiration in a growing industry, so there is no shortfall that would trigger problemistic search.

The hyaluronic serum stays on the website and sits close to the core offer at low incremental cost, so the firm's slack lets it carry the product even though its lower visibility leaves its results uncertain.
The cleansing oil launched in 2024 is too new to judge against aspirations, and it likely took over the cleansing role after the cleansing milk was dropped, so management will give it more time.
